name: Champion
summary: Pure martial excellence: wider Critical Hit range, athletic edge and stubborn survival.

feature.name: Improved Critical
feature.summary: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

feature.name: Remarkable Athlete
feature.summary: Advantage on Initiative and Strength (Athletics) checks; move half your Speed after a Critical Hit.
feature.text: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. Right after you score a Critical Hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

feature.name: Heroic Warrior
feature.summary: In combat, gain Heroic Inspiration at the start of your turn if you have none.

feature.name: Superior Critical
feature.summary: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks score a Critical Hit on 18-20.

feature.name: Survivor
feature.summary: Advantage on Death Saving Throws (18-20 counts as 20); regain 5 + Con modifier HP each turn while Bloodied.
feature.text: Defy Death: you have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and a roll of 18-20 counts as a 20. Heroic Rally: at the start of each of your turns, if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point, you regain 5 + your Constitution modifier Hit Points.
